description: This source file contains unit tests for the TalkAudioPlayer class, which handles audio playback. It includes test cases to verify that playback does not hang under certain conditions, such as ending or failing, and when called twice. Additionally, it provides utility functions for creating WAV audio data with specific properties and handling timeout scenarios.

classes.name: TimeoutError
classes.description: An internal error used for signaling a timeout.

methods.name: withTimeout
methods.description: Executes a given asynchronous work unit with a timeout, throwing a TimeoutError if the work exceeds the specified duration.

methods.name: makeWav16Mono
methods.description: Generates a WAV audio Data buffer containing silence with specified sample rate and number of samples.
